title: Choosing COD locks Credit Limit at $0.00 with the reason on hover
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Start on the Customers page.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Type 500 in Credit Limit.
  3. Choose "COD" in Credit Terms.
  4. Hover Credit Limit.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Customer" window opens.

Step 2:

  • Credit Limit reads 500.

Step 3:

  • Credit Limit changes to $0.00 and is disabled.

Step 4:

  • The hover reads "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R4: “When the chosen term is COD or Credit Hold, Credit Limit shows $0.00 and is disabled; hovering it shows "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit." Choosing COD or Credit Hold sets the limit to $0.00.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover the locked Credit Limit (COD or Credit Hold) | "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit." | Tooltip on hover”
  • Key Decisions: “COD and Credit Hold customers have a $0 credit limit that cannot be changed, in New Customer and Edit Customer, and imports and the Public API save them with $0 (S10-R6, S10-R8).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
